responsibility: Declares the processor-independent option table for VxWorks targets. It defines driver options like -Bdynamic, -Bstatic, -non-static, -Xbind-lazy, and -Xbind-now for normal VxWorks, plus target options such as -mrtp and the AE-only -mvthreads, with conditions keyed to the VxWorks variant macros. The file is declarative option metadata supporting VxWorks specs and hooks.
same_name_distinction: This file is the processor-independent VxWorks option metadata, declaring driver and target switches such as -Bdynamic, -Bstatic, -Xbind-*, -mrtp, and AE-only -mvthreads; gcc/config/vxworks.h and gcc/config/vxworks.cc provide the actual configuration policy and helper implementations those options support.
